content_of_post_to_comment:
Around 4-5 months ago I quit all internet media that I found un-important/time wasters. For example youtube drama, commentating on drama or anything of the sort. Discord, only in 1 server my IRL friend added me to. Only listen to podcasts about horror stories, stories, novels, and real life events.

Last week, school started. The first week was so fucking productive. I got up, did my routine and went to school without touching my phone. Studied for 1 and a half hours daily.

The real problem raised on Friday. One day before Saturday, I had decided to go out with my brother for shopping. Came back late, didn't study.

The next day, I opened my phone first thing.

The difference was so clear. Like an instant plummet in focus or direction in the first 30 seconds of putting phone down getting up, and deciding what to do. Staying there for the rest of the day.

Currently Tuesday. I've noticed this and plan to start with the old routine next day. No phone. Actually studied.

Any tips?
